title: 3-Ingredient "Halfway Homemade" Ice Cream
instructions: Crush the entire pack of Oreos.
Mix the crushed Oreos into the vanilla frozen yogurt.
Fold in a full tub of Cool Whip until combined.
notes: Creator's mom's recipe — uses vanilla frozen yogurt instead of churning ice cream from scratch, hence 'halfway homemade.' Creator confirmed in comments to use the WHOLE pack of Oreos, not a partial pack. Variation from a commenter: spread in a 9x13 pan and top with extra crushed Oreos for an ice-cream-cake style dessert. Another commenter warned that scaling up (e.g., a 4L tub of vanilla ice cream) with a full tub of Cool Whip and a full pack of Oreos can be too much volume for one container — stick close to the original proportions. Video only partially describes exact technique; full method inferred from caption + comments.
